_comment: Source photo per piece. The catalogue leads several totems with in-hand shots and several pieces with worn shots; neither can be used as a relight reference, so this map is hand-picked and must not be derived from image order.

_shelf_exclude.starshipkey-pendant: Relight keeps reinventing it — comes back dark bronze with an invented slot. Five attempts, all wrong the same way. Its only clean photo still has the chain in it. Revisit with a chain-free shot.
_shelf_exclude.macon-cap: Fabric, not a cast piece; dropped from the shelves as a poor fit for an archive shelf. Still sold, still in the Index.
_shelf_exclude.eclipse-ring: Only photographed from directly above, so a side-on view has to be invented and the model adds structure that is not on the real ring. Needs a photo of it standing.
